question.text: A parallel plate capacitor with width <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>, length <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> and separation between the plates of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math> is connected to a battery of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math>. A dielectric slab of dielectric constant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn></math> having length <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>, width <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> and thickness <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math> is inserted between the plates of parallel plate capacitor. The electrostatic energy of this system will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math>. (Where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>ϵ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></math> is the permittivity of free space)

solution.text:
The figure below shows the parallel plate capacitor with dielectric slab placed in between the plates.

Now, the effective capacitance of the combination is 

Ceff=ε07×4410+5ε01×4410×10-2

=70ε0+50ε0×10-2=120ε0×10-2

⇒Ceff =1.2ε0

Electrostatics energy of this system is =12CeffV2

=121.2ε02020=240ε0
